subtopics.title: Data Collection and Curation
subtopics.summary: The process of gathering raw data, filtering it, removing duplicates, and performing overlap analysis to build a high-quality dataset foundation.

subtopics.title: Data Annotation and Quality Control
subtopics.summary: Creating annotation guidelines, labeling data, fact-checking annotations, and removing sensitive or toxic information to ensure dataset accuracy.

subtopics.title: Data Synthesis and Verification
subtopics.summary: Generating synthetic instructions using templates, verifying data quality, and balancing data diversity with volume to improve model training.

subtopics.title: Dataset Evaluation and Benchmarking
subtopics.summary: Assessing dataset quality by training models on them and measuring performance on downstream tasks, using benchmarks such as DataPerf and dcbench.
